description: This file declares the TCPSocketStarboard class, which manages TCP socket operations on the Starboard platform, including connection, reading, writing, binding, listening, and socket configuration.

classes.name: TCPSocketStarboard
classes.description: A class that encapsulates TCP socket operations on the Starboard platform, supporting connection management, data transfer, socket options, and event handling.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: AdoptConnectedSocket
methods.description: Takes ownership of an already connected socket.

methods.name: AdoptUnconnectedSocket
methods.description: Takes ownership of a socket that may not be connected.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific local address.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Marks the socket as listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to a remote address.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Reads data if the socket is ready.

methods.name: CancelReadIfReady
methods.description: Cancels a read if ready operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address.

methods.name: SetDefaultOptionsForServer
methods.description: Sets default socket options for server mode.

methods.name: SetDefaultOptionsForClient
methods.description: Sets default socket options for client mode.

methods.name: AllowAddressReuse
methods.description: Enables address reuse.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SetKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keep-alive.

methods.name: SetNoDelay
methods.description: Enables or disables Nagle's algorithm.

methods.name: SetIPv6Only
methods.description: Sets IPv6 only mode.

methods.name: GetEstimatedRoundTripTime
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated RTT.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: EnableTCPFastOpenIfSupported
methods.description: No-op; TCP FastOpen not supported in Windows.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the socket is valid.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches the socket from the current thread.

methods.name: StartLoggingMultipleConnectAttempts
methods.description: Marks the start of multiple connect attempts for logging.

methods.name: EndLoggingMultipleConnectAttempts
methods.description: Marks the end of multiple connect attempts for logging.

methods.name: net_log
methods.description: Returns the associated NetLogWithSource object.

methods.name: ReleaseSocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor and cleans up the object for testing.

methods.name: SocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor without releasing ownership.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag.

methods.name: socket_performance_watcher
methods.description: Returns the socket performance watcher.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific network handle.

methods.name: OnSocketReadyToRead
methods.description: Callback when socket is ready to read.

methods.name: OnSocketReadyToWrite
methods.description: Callback when socket is ready to write.
